episodes.title: The Wandering Knight Sets Out to Make the World a Better Place
episodes.summary: This show contains scenes that some viewers may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised. A video game lover awakes to find himself in a medieval fantasy world as his character, a Holy Knight named Arc. As exciting as the opportunity seems at first, he realizes that his comical selection of the skull face for his avatar has resulted in a ghastly appearance that will make him a target if revealed. Will Arc be able to undertake the daring life of an adventurer without revealing his identity?

episodes.title: A First Job, a Girl's Wish, and an Approaching Shadow
episodes.summary: Arc begins his days an adventurer-for-hire, but in spite of his fearsome strength, he still needs to keep a low profile. Luckily, he finds the perfect inaugural quest for his inconspicuous new life... or does he?

episodes.title: An Austere Elf Dances for Her Comrades
episodes.summary: Arc encounters the elf warrior Ariane, who is suspicious about humans due to the bigotry that elves face in the realm. But when a slave ring that captures elf children surfaces, Arc's desire for an inconspicuous lifestyle and his compulsion to do the right thing will be weighed against each other.

episodes.title: Infiltrating the Slave Market! In Search of the World's Evil
episodes.summary: With the help of one of Ariane's comrades, she and Arc head to the town of Diento to break up the local elf slave trade.

episodes.title: A Secret Revealed, and a Bond Forged
episodes.summary: Arc and Ariane make their way into the palace of Marquis Diento. What kind of political fallout will there be from one of the Rhoden nobles possessing enslaved elves?

episodes.title: Learning About the Darkness of This World at the Elf Village
episodes.summary: While Ariane and her father travel to the elvish city of Maple to discuss her ongoing mission, Arc finds himself getting an unexpected lesson from her mother, Glenys.

episodes.title: A Miracle for the High-Minded Princess
episodes.summary: With Arc and Ariane's newly minted partnership having been made official, they set out together for the royal capital of Olav, in pursuit of the slave-trading ring that has kidnapped so many elves.

episodes.title: Allied! Dashing Through the Darkness With the Beastpeople!
episodes.summary: An unexpected reunion with the furry-eared ninja, Chiyome, leads to Arc learning more about the world he's found himself in.

episodes.title: The Capital in Chaos and a Maiden's Oath
episodes.summary: Arc, Ariane, Chiyome, and Goemon launch an attack on the Etzat Market, the single largest slave market in the kingdom of Rhoden.

episodes.title: Hope for the Future Found in the Desert
episodes.summary: Arc and Ariane head to the Holy Revlon Empire to hunt elf slave traders, but without a clear way forward their path could be perilous. Luckily, a stranger approaches them with a job offer that could make the way forward clearer.

episodes.title: The Monster-Taming Barbarian Laughs in the Darkness
episodes.summary: Arc and Ariane have followed the trail of kidnapped elves to a fortress within the Holy Revlon Empire, but they have no way of knowing the vicious threats waiting inside.

episodes.title: I Shall Cut Through the World's Evils!
episodes.summary: The colossal regenerating force of nature known as a hydra is headed straight for the town of Kaysehk, and with Ariane and Chiyome hunting down the beast's master, only Arc can stand in it's way.

episodes.title: Duel to the Death? Silver Knight VS Silver Knight!
episodes.summary: Arc continues his journey with his new friends, when they run into a human trafficking ring.

episodes.title: The Toxic Fangs of Assassination Target the Elvish Blade
episodes.summary: Arc and Ariane visit a human and elf pair of newlyweds, who are attracting animosity for their marriage.

episodes.title: The Fall of Villains and the Dance of Sibling Love
episodes.summary: Arc and Ariane head to a city where a young performer is being manipulated into aiding a kidnapping ring.

episodes.title: The Cursed Village Where the Saint's Soul Roams
episodes.summary: Ariane's sister, Eevin, calls on Ariane and Arc to help her investigate a sanctuary for elves.

episodes.title: Terror! Shadows of Undeath Lurking Down Below
episodes.summary: After discovering a lurking undead threat, Arc, Ariane, and Eevin fight to free the captives of the plot.

episodes.title: The Nature of This World Floats Upon the Dragon King's Spring
episodes.summary: Arc reaches the spring that could cure his skeletal nature, but first he'll have to get past it's guardian.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Chivalry Blooms at the Shinobi Village!
The Sea Hears the Tale of the Tragic Kunoichi's Past
episodes.summary: As Arc and the group travel to the southern continent, Chiyome shares her past with Sasuke.

episodes.title: Reunited to the Sound of a Dark Beast's Howl
episodes.summary: Arc and his party are reunited with Danka, who tells them about his mission and the threat to it.
